children: F&G’s revenue declined year over year, while earnings increased. Lower life insurance premiums and other fees, interest and investment income, and owned distribution revenue were partly offset by higher recognized gains; earnings benefited from lower policy-reserve costs and favorable market risk benefit movements.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net earnings attributable to F&G common shareholders”. ³ Reported as “Net earnings per share attributable to F&G common shareholders, diluted”.
: Gross sales were $3.00B and net sales were $1.41B; indexed annuity sales rose while PRT and MYGA sales declined year over year.
: Sales attributable to flow reinsurance to third parties were $1.60B, primarily reflecting new reinsurance and changes in percentages ceded.
: Interest and investment income was $698M, down from $748M, primarily due to lower alternative investment returns and rate and mix impacts.
: Personnel and other operating expenses totaled $103M, down from $117M, reflecting disciplined expense management and costs in line with sales volumes and asset growth.
